primary.mechanism_summary: Compute each name's trailing market-residual daily returns (rolling regression of stock returns on the cross-sectional market factor), form medium-horizon momentum on the residual component (6-12 month formation, ~1 month skip), scale by residual volatility, and rank cross-sectionally. Long the top-ranked residual-momentum names, short the bottom-ranked, emitting raw signed weights from the ranks. The mechanism isolates persistence in firm-specific performance while discarding the beta tilts that drive classical momentum crashes.
primary.economic_rationale: Investors underreact to firm-specific news: idiosyncratic information diffuses slowly (limited attention, gradual analyst/flow response), so the residual return component trends at multi-month horizons. Stripping the market component removes the time-varying beta exposure that causes raw momentum's crash risk and makes the anomaly a purer, less crowded cross-sectional bet - a natural fit for a beta-capped market-neutral book on ~65 liquid single-stock perps. Slow-moving ranks keep daily turnover low, so the edge is not consumed by 6 bps/side costs.
primary.expected_regime_behavior: Bull: steady positive carry as idiosyncratic winners persist (e.g. AI-cycle leaders vs laggards) without needing a market tilt. Bear/crash: materially milder drawdowns than raw momentum, since momentum crashes (2020-03, 2009-style reversals) are dominated by the beta component this family removes; residual books de-risk gracefully under the engine's vol target. Chop/rotation: worst regime - sharp cross-sectional factor rotations (2021-style growth/value whipsaws) temporarily invert residual ranks; expect flat-to-mildly-negative stretches rather than tail losses.
primary.falsifier: If, across the pre-registered formation plateau (126-252 trading-day formation, 10-21 day skip, tercile-to-decile book widths), the strategy cannot achieve net IS Sharpe at 1x cost >= 0.3 on team-run output, or the residual construction fails to beat the equivalent raw-return momentum book on both net Sharpe and max drawdown (i.e. beta-stripping adds nothing), or turnover costs consume more than half of gross Sharpe at every plateau point, the family is dead and I pivot.

backups.mechanism_summary: Fade multi-day idiosyncratic gaps of each name versus its sector_map basket (z-scored spread), long underperformers / short outperformers as liquidity provision, with entry/exit bands to control turnover.
Rank names by closeness of price to their trailing 252-day high and go long near-high / short far-from-high, exploiting anchoring-driven underreaction with very low turnover.
